Three pages, one ecosystem

Home keeps engine/showcase, publishing, Bootcamp and partner sections. Community and Assets have their own pages, with inline detail panels and dialog forms.

All forms are local demonstrations. New questions and replies exist only until this page reloads. No application, payment, download or Discord message is sent. Images are AI-generated voxel concept illustrations, not Gemu engine screenshots or real asset listings.

Client priorities, access qualification, Bootcamp details, asset licensing and the forum/Discord integration remain to confirm. See HANDOFF.md for the developer review.
